text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Japanese Derby―― Gold City 
was even more keyed up than usual, 
determined to rewrite everyone's 
perception of her today.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her Trainer warned her that public opinion 
wouldn't change overnight, but she paid it 
no mind.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Gold City headed out to the race to earn 
the title of Derby Umamusume.
